milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the lodestone at spawn-relative (4, 0, 2) and face toward it, confirming they have visually identified the distinctive compass rose pattern block with lantern on top. Max distance 16 with 60° facing tolerance models 'player can see the lodestone'.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the cluster of 5 yellow concrete powder blocks centered at spawn-relative (4, 0, 7) and face toward them, confirming visual identification of the bright yellow stripe on the floor. Max distance 16 with 60° facing tolerance.

Uses inventory_has because mining an acacia trapdoor causes it to drop as an item that enters the player's inventory. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks since the mined drop ends up in inventory and is not in the starting inventory. The player must break at least one of the two stacked acacia trapdoors blocking the passage at z=12.

Uses position_near_with_facing with a tight max_distance of 3 blocks because playing a record requires the player to be directly in front of the jukebox at spawn-relative (4, 0, 17) and facing it to right-click/use. While use_item events are not a supported rule type, being within 3 blocks AND facing the jukebox (60° tolerance) strongly confirms the player has navigated to and oriented toward the jukebox for interaction — the necessary precondition for inserting the music disc. This is the best available rule type for interaction tasks.
